description: Sell music gear on Reverb: create, update, publish and end listings, ship orders, answer buyers' messages and offers, and leave feedback.

reverb_new_feedback_trigger.description: Runs for each new feedback in Reverb. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.feedback: The whole feedback as Reverb gives it.

reverb_new_offer_trigger.description: Runs for each new offer in Reverb. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.offer: The whole offer as Reverb gives it.
output.offer_id: The offer's id, for 'Accept or decline offer' and 'Counter offer'.

reverb_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new order in Reverb. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. Paid or not, each comes with the buyer and what they paid.

output.order: The whole order as Reverb gives it.
output.order_number: The order's number, for the order steps.
output.ship_to: Where it ships to, such as Chicago, IL, United States.
output.sku: The listing's SKU, if it has one.
output.status: Its status, such as paid, shipped or cancelled.
output.title: What was bought: the listing's title.
output.total: What the buyer paid, such as $83.

reverb_new_refund_request_trigger.description: Runs for each new refund request in Reverb. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.amount: How much the buyer asks back, such as $87.
output.refund_request: The whole request as Reverb gives it.

reverb_new_unread_conversation_trigger.description: Runs for each new unread conversation in Reverb. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. A conversation turns unread when a buyer writes to you.

output.conversation: The whole conversation as Reverb lists it.
output.conversation_id: The conversation's id, for 'Get conversation' and 'Send message'.
output.url: The conversation's page on Reverb, if Reverb gives one.

reverb_order_ready_to_ship_trigger.description: Runs for each order ready to ship in Reverb. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. An order is ready once it is paid and waiting for you to ship it.

output.order: The whole order as Reverb gives it.
output.order_number: The order's number, for the order steps.
output.ship_to: Where it ships to, such as Chicago, IL, United States.
output.sku: The listing's SKU, if it has one.
output.status: Its status, such as paid, shipped or cancelled.
output.title: What was bought: the listing's title.
output.total: What the buyer paid, such as $83.

reverb_order_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time an order status changes in Reverb. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan. A new order counts too, with its first status.

output.order: The whole order as Reverb gives it.
output.order_number: The order's number, for the order steps.
output.ship_to: Where it ships to, such as Chicago, IL, United States.
output.sku: The listing's SKU, if it has one.
output.status: Its status, such as paid, shipped or cancelled.
output.title: What was bought: the listing's title.
output.total: What the buyer paid, such as $83.

parameters.description: Only when the order moves to one of these statuses, separated by commas: unpaid, payment_pending, pending_review, blocked, paid, shipped, picked_up, received, refunded or cancelled. Leave blank for every change.
parameters.name: status
